correctness.rationale: Every automorphism acts by a signed edge permutation on each real \(\ell_q\); stabilizer antisymmetry proves no equivariant B-to-Z or Z-to-B map. Averaging yields both simultaneous norm-minimal orthogonal projections. An explicit solution of the graph Laplacian yields the full transfer-current edge classification and exact \(\ell_1\) and \(\ell_\infty\) column sums; the discrete difference establishes the corrected phase threshold \(p=8\). Exact-rational tests of 20 finite graph sizes and 780 difference identities corroborate but do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The minimum norm of projections onto cycle and cut spaces is a canonical Banach-space and transportation-cost invariant. This gives both sharp constants and constructive, symmetry-rigid minimizers for infinitely many graphs and all real \(\ell_q\), plus a genuine part-count monotonicity transition (\(p=5,6,7\)), not a routine renaming or a single small-graph computation.
